# JavaScript API

Everything `pb_hooks` and page code can call, generated from the TypeScript declarations PocketOne ships (the same ones your app's `types.d.ts` gets, so your editor knows them too).

## PocketBase

What core gives every app: [the globals, hooks, functions and classes](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) (`$app`, `$apis`, `$security`, `routerAdd`, `cronAdd`, `onRecordCreate`, `new Record()`...), and the types they hand you, one page per Go namespace:

- PocketBase's: [apis](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/apis), [auth](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/auth), [blob](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/blob), [core](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core), [cron](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/cron), [dbx](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx), [filesystem](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filesystem), [forms](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/forms), [hook](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook), [logger](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/logger), [mailer](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/mailer), [pocketbase](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/pocketbase), [router](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router), [search](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/search), [store](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/store), [subscriptions](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/subscriptions), [template](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/template), [types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types)
- From the Go libraries it builds on: [bufio](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bufio), [bytes](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/bytes), [cobra](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/cobra), [context](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context), [exec](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/exec), [filepath](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/filepath), [fs](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/fs), [http](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/http), [io](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/io), [jwt](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/jwt), [multipart](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/multipart), [net](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net), [oauth2](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/oauth2), [os](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/os), [ozzo_validation](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/ozzo_validation), [slog](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog), [sql](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql), [sync](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sync), [syntax](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/syntax), [syscall](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/syscall), [textproto](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/textproto), [time](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time), [url](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/url)

## Extensions

Each PocketOne extension adds to that: a global such as `$llm`, functions to bind hooks, types. Each page below lists what one extension adds. An extension that's off on your app adds nothing.

| Extension | Adds |
|---|---|
| [API Tokens](/docs/reference/javascript/api-tokens) | `tokens`, `$apiTokens` |
| [Bulk Mail](/docs/reference/javascript/bulkmail) | `bulkmail`, `$bulkmail` |
| [Key-Value Store](/docs/reference/javascript/kv) | `$kv` |
| [LLM](/docs/reference/javascript/llm) | `$llm` |
| [MCP](/docs/reference/javascript/mcp) | `mcp`, `$mcp` |
| [Pages](/docs/reference/javascript/pages) | `pages`, `JSX` |
| [WASM](/docs/reference/javascript/wasm) | `$wasm` |
| [Contract hooks](/docs/reference/javascript/contracts) | `contracts`, `onContracts`, `ContractError`, `contracts.bulkmail.v1`, `onBulkmailCount`, `onBulkmailStart`, `onBulkmailPause`, `onBulkmailResume`, and 94 more |
